items.question: Under the UAE Student Code of Conduct, how many conduct points are deducted for a first-degree (simple) violation?
items.gold: 4 points are deducted for a first-degree (simple) violation.
items.fact: First-degree violation deducts four conduct points under the Student Code.

items.question: Under the UAE Student Code of Conduct, what is the minimum score expected in student conduct?
items.gold: The minimum score expected in conduct is 60 per cent.
items.fact: Minimum expected student conduct score is sixty per cent.
